Resolves #21125

#21092 added a claim-responder case for sibling repositories, and its stub for the linked-PR read has no `pageInfo`. An hour later #21103 merged; it makes exactly that read fail closed, but its base didn't include #21092's case. The stub now answers one complete page (`pageInfo: {hasNextPage: false}`), like the three stubs #21103 updated, and the spec passes on `dev` again. The workflow guard is unchanged.

Evidence: L2 (the spec runs against the unchanged workflow script) → L2 required (AC-1 is the spec passing; AC-2 is the workflow staying unchanged). No residuals.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical. It is a one-line test fixture brought in line with its three sibling stubs.
